messages:
maria_cs: Heads-up — we're kicking off a small 'Night‑Owl' preview cohort next week (12 customers). Goal: fast feedback on onboarding flow + early billing/perf signal. Will need enrollment invites, a short enablement session, and a feedback rotation.

ajay_sales: nice. which accounts are in the cohort? any renewals we should flag?

maria_cs: list is in the doc: https://redwood.workspace/preview/night-owl (internal). Quick callouts: 3 mid-market renewals in Q3, 2 high-risk (low usage) accounts.

samira_cs: I'll draft the invite template and the 30m enablement deck. Want to run a 20m live demo + 10m Q&A.

devon_eng: I'll prepare a small telemetry dashboard for cohort users (latency, error rate, token usage). ETA Tue.

onboard-bot: Reminder: create calendar event and set RSVP window to 48h.

maria_cs: thanks. Samira — can you add a simple 'how we measure success' slide: onboarding completion rate, first 1000 tokens/day, and feedback NPS?

samira_cs: yep. Also proposing a two-step feedback loop: 1) in-session short poll, 2) follow-up form at day 7.

luis_product: make sure follow-up form includes 2 qualitative prompts: "where did flow break?" and "what feature would save you time?" Also add dropdown for priority (P0/P1/P2).

ajay_sales: for the 3 renewing accounts — can we align CSM + AE on renewal talktrack if adoption low? I'll own outreach after enablement.

maria_cs: assign owners here: Renewals = ajay_sales, Primary CSMs = samira_cs (lead), secondary = nora_ops for ops blockers.

nora_ops: I'll provision sandbox entitlements and preseed sample data for demos. Need list of IAM emails.

samira_cs: putting draft invite below — please react :thumbsup: if ok, :pencil: for edits.

```
Subject: Night-Owl Preview — quick onboarding + feedback session
When: Thu 10am PT (30m)
What: 20m demo + 10m Q&A + in-session poll
Prep: small dataset, API key (demo), calendar invite
Follow-up: day-0 poll + day-7 survey
```

maria_cs: also planning an internal scoreboard (private) to track: enrollments, attended, poll score, follow-up response rate. We'll use it to mark any renewal escalation.

devon_eng: FYI I'll add an alert if any cohort user spikes error rate > 5% or latency > 2x baseline so we can triage live.

luis_product: please add a short release note about behavior changes in the new onboarding flow so AEs can set expectations.

samira_cs: timeline: invite today, enablement Thurs, follow-up survey next Thurs, sync retrospective the following Tue.

ajay_sales: I'll ping the 3 renewal contacts personally after the session and surface verbatim feedback to renewals thread.

maria_cs: perfect. final checklist: invites sent, dashboard live, sandbox provisioned, enablement deck ready, follow-up form built. Call out blockers here.

nora_ops: blocker — need IAM list by EOD for sandbox.

samira_cs: I'll assemble invite + deck now. tagging @onboard-bot to create the calendar event.

onboard-bot: Event created: Night-Owl Preview — Thu 10am PT (30m). RSVP link: https://cal.redwood/event/abc123

maria_cs: great job team — we'll run a short internal dry-run 30m before public session. Meeting invite to follow.
